card.name: "Contribute to" in C. difficile warning
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "contribute" in the standard sentence "C. difficile produces toxins A and B which contribute to the development of CDAD/CDI". It appears in antibacterial-associated diarrhea warnings.

modes.label: Toxins contribute to CDAD
modes.description: The word "to" after "contribute" in the C. difficile toxin sentence, before "the development of".
modes.example: with antibacterial agents alters the normal flora of the colon leading to overgrowth of C. difficile . C. difficile produces toxins A and B which contribute<< to>> the development of CDI. Hypert

card.plain: It fires on the word "to" in the stock sentence saying C. difficile toxins contribute to the development of diarrhea or colitis.
